groups.title: Square Masks
groups.theme: Heads drawn as boxes inside boxes: square eyes with spirals and targets, rows of teeth, every corner of the square filled.

groups.title: Round Masks and Profiles
groups.theme: Heads drawn as rings and ovals, or turned sideways into profile, with hearts, flowers and crosses for eyes.

groups.title: Scribbled Heads
groups.theme: Heads buried in tangles of line, most on black, slate or brown grounds, nearly all with teeth bared.

groups.title: Figures and Places
groups.theme: What else was drawn in the mask months: single figures, crowds, a dog, a crow, a robot, a valley and a tree.
